question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

MODERN
solution:
The correct answer is: Ancient

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Modern means of the present or recent times.

 
 
• Example - *Pollution is one of the major problems in the **modern **world.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Ancient means belonging to a period of history that is thousands of years in the past.
 
 
• Example - *Archaeologists study the remains of **ancient **civilizations.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Modern' and 'Ancient' are opposite in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 2.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Creaky describes the grating sound, and also the worn-out or run-down nature of old things or people.
 
• Popular means liked, enjoyed, or admired by many people or by most people in a particular group.
 
• Well-known means known by a lot of people; famous.
